notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207943/cee97d149051ba91f4b1a53e298cf5613cc6ad19.png[/img]

New Main Story [Folie et Déraison]

At the end of the Earth, on the brink of civilization, a panoramic prison exists beyond the bounds of reason, following a narrative incomprehensible to all. 
Every "resident" here harbors dreams, and every "visitor" comes with their own purpose. Amid the chaotic madness of countless faces, they must peel back the truth, layer by layer.
[Eligibility]: Complete the main story [Tristes Tropiques].

Main Event
[Eligibility]: Complete the main story 1ST-16 [Heaven Apostles].
[Duration]: After the version update on 2025-05-29 - 2025-06-30 04:59 (UTC-5)
[Event Shop]: After the version update on 2025-05-29 - 2025-07-03 04:59 (UTC-5)
[Event Intro]: The new main story [Folie et Déraison] and battles will be available during the event. Consume Cellular Activity in Main Story, Insight, and Resource stages (excluding Reflections stages) to gain [Wealth Indicator] and possibly gain [Picrasma Gummy]. [Wealth Indicator] can be exchanged for event rewards in the event shop [Behind Bars Book Club].
※[Picrasma Gummy]: Bear-shaped candies, always the first to sell out. It restores a small amount of Cellular Activity, yet its shelf life is short. Enjoy it before it expires!
[Main Rewards]: Clear Drop, Wealth Indicator, Picrasma Gummy

[Lucidscape] New Regularly Updated Gameplay
[Eligibility]: Complete [Surface - Weyerhaeuser Forest β]
[Duration]: After 2025-06-01 05:00 (UTC-5)
[Event Intro]:
1. A new experimental project from Artificial Somnambulism. Enter Lucidscape, face unique challenges, and earn generous rewards.
2. Lucidscape contains 4 layers, each divided into two halves. Characters used in the first half of a layer cannot be deployed in the second half. Each stage features two standard challenge objectives and one high-difficulty objective. Completion determines the [Ratings] awarded.
3. Before each layer begins, you can choose [Dream Buffs] to strengthen your team. Buffs selected for the first half cannot be reused in the second half. Buffs can be reselected when entering a new layer or after resetting the challenge.
4. Earn certain [Ratings] of varying levels in Lucidscape for the first time to receive one-time Clear Drops and growth materials.
5. Lucidscape resets on the 1st of each month. Challenge progress and non-first-clear rewards will reset. Based on the number of [A Ratings] earned in the current session, you may start from Layer 3 in the next session.
[Main Rewards]: Clear Drop x700
Limbo Adjustments
1. Starting with Limbo opening on 2025-06-16 (UTC-5), each session's duration will extend to one month. Future sessions will refresh at 05:00 (UTC-5) on the 16th of each month.
2. Limbo will expand to 7 layers, offering a total of Clear Drop x700.
3. From this session onward, once you clear Limbo with full stars, you can directly claim all rewards of the first 4 layers and start challenging from the 5th layer in the next session.

Dear Timekeeper,
Reverse: 1999 will undergo scheduled update maintenance at 2024-12-05 05:00 (UTC-5). During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game. Please take note of the update time and schedule your game play accordingly. After the maintenance ends, please update the game over a stable network connection. 
[Update Maintenance Duration]
2024-12-05 05:00 - 2024-12-05 10:00 (UTC-5)
※ Update duration may be adjusted due to unforeseen circumstances; please pay attention to official announcements.
[Maintenance Compensation]
Compensation for update maintenance: Clear Drop x300, Jar of Picrasma Candy (time-limited) x2
※ Compensation eligibility: All Timekeepers who registered and created characters prior to the update at 2024-12-05 05:00 (UTC-5).
※ Log in during Version 2.1 to receive your rewards via mail. The mail will remain valid for 7 days.
Compensation for bug fixing: Clear Drop x180
※ Compensation eligibility: All Timekeepers who registered and created characters prior to the update at 2024-12-05 05:00 (UTC-5).
※ Log in during Version 2.1 to receive your rewards via mail. The mail will remain valid for 7 days.

Gift Details: Clear Drop x600, Jar of Picrasma Candy (time-limited) x5, Roar Decibel x10000
※ Log in during Version 2.1 to receive your rewards via mail. The mail will remain valid until the end of Version 2.1.
[Update Content Preview]
1. New Characters
6-star character [Tuesday (Spirit)], 6-star character [Argus (Plant)], 5-star character [Barbara (Spirit)].
2. New Psychubes
6-star Psychube [And the Maid Says]: Can be redeemed from [Clandestine Concierge] when it's open.
6-star Psychube [Stray Off the Path]: Can be redeemed from the Psychube Shop after 2024-12-26 05:00.
5-star Psychube [Spinning Yarns]: Can be obtained during the [Anecdote] event.
5-star Psychube [The Unknown Artist]: Can be obtained during the [Anecdote] event.
3. New Events
[Route 77: The Haunted Highway] Main Event, [Tuesday - Bedtime Story], [Argus - The Red Wall], [Room Service Voucher I], [Room Service Voucher II], [Winternight Gift Box], [A Series of Dusks - Rhapsody of the Moon], [Mane's Bulletin - Winter Special], [Anecdotes], [UTTU Spotlight Edition: Stories on the Route], [Double Analysis], and [Gifts From Across the Equator].
※ For more info, please check 2.1 - [Route 77: The Haunted Highway] Contents Overview.
4. A Series of Dusks - Rhapsody of the Moon
A Series of Dusks comes with a new expansion: [Rhapsody of the Moon], bringing with it the new feature [Suite of the Moon] , [Stress] battle effect, and new Catalysts, Stages, Artefacts, and Encounters.
※ After the update, the current performance progress still underway will be cleared. Please complete your progress before the maintenance begins.
5. Mane's Bulletin - Winter Special
Mane's Bulletin now has a new mode: [Breaking Catastrophe]. When battling in this mode, enemy combat mechanics will undergo huge changes, and the battle effects of our certain ally characters will be significantly strengthened.

[Roar Jukebox: Into The Fog]

Isolde - [And All That Jazz], Ezra - [Yee-Haw!], TTT - [Saturday Special], Blonney - [The Giallo Grind].

[Harvest of Horror], [Harvest of Fear], [Gift of a Dream], [Bedtime Gift], [Collection of Thoughts], [Materials Bonanza], [Materials Party], [Yearning of the Snow], [Nourishing Snow Offer], [Nourishing Snow Bargain].
